svg.title: Interceptor — power: SysML v2 interconnection view of InterceptorDrone
svg.text: Two independent rails: PM02 feeds the flight controller, the Matek BEC feeds the Pi.
WIRE LIST — every connection in this view
XT60 — 6S main power into the power module
XT60 pigtail, 14 AWG — PM02 pass-through to the ESC pads
3-phase leads, soldered — 4 channels; verify order + direction in QGC (afr-03)
6-pin JST-GH — 5.2 V + analog V/I sense to POWER1
16 AWG tap on the main leads — LiPo main straight to the BEC -- second rail
5 V lead to the Pi (entry point TBD) — 5.2 V; USB-C pigtail or header 5 V/GND -- decide at afr-05
soldered across the rail at the Pi end — 1000 uF 16 V low-ESR
10-pin JST-GH — GPS UART (UBX 10 Hz) + IST8310 compass on GPS1's own I2C + 5 V
RC IN socket — SBUS (ELRS flashed to SBUS out) + 5 V; kill/arm only
TBD — drive pin UNRESOLVED -- the 6C Mini has no buzzer pad
